scope: Manually read network architecture and all nine written sequence groups on AM703-AM706. Source language and ambiguity are preserved. Bounded text corroboration does not resolve engineering contradictions or establish installed controller/sensor counts.

drawn_groups.label: Unit heaters and ductless split system

controller_quantity.reason: The source expressly calls controller number and arrangement diagrammatic, to be designed by the DDC contractor. Four drawn group boxes are not a four-controller takeoff.

wiring_quantities.reason: No takeoff length, address roster or terminal allocation supplied by this network schematic.

network.caveat: The architecture is USB-specific and does not establish that gatehouse/guard-booth devices use the same individual links or controller allocations. Legend protocol names alone do not prove every point is a network object instead of physical I/O.

logic: PI control unless otherwise specified. Below low limit, coolers/control loops disabled and bypass open for building circulation; above low limit, enable lead cooler and modulate bypass using pre-pump CWR temperature AI-6.
At 100% bypass opening reset high limit to 90 F. Spray pump engages at reset setpoint minus 4 F; cooler fans engage above reset plus 2 F and modulate. Reverse on falling CWR temperature.

With no compressors enabled: pumps/coolers off, minimum bypass open and lead/lag shutoff valves closed. With compressors enabled: start lead condenser-water pump, open associated compressor isolation valves and modulate pump flow to the operating-combination table.
After compressors stop, ramp pump to minimum speed, modulate minimum-flow bypass and retain pump operation for 15 minutes adjustable.
On lead cooler or pump failure de-energize failed equipment and energize standby pump as written; alternate lead/lag on weekly schedule and runtime.
alarms: Any compressor CWR temperature 110 degrees or higher
source_conflicts: Mode paragraph mixes CWS, CWR and ZN variable names. Low-limit paragraph references AI-1, while setpoint list uses AI-6 and calls it MAIN CWR TEMPERATURE; the points matrix calls AI-1 MAIN CWR and AI-6 CWR BEFORE PUMPS.
V-3 is modulated by AO-1 in AM702/AM703; VLV-3 in AM602 is scheduled TWO POSITION.
AM610 shows NO on V-1, V-2 and V-4 through V-10; AM702 shows NC at those valves. V-3 and V-11 show NO on both.
Immediate no-compressor shutdown paragraph must be reconciled with the subsequent 15-minute pump overrun, rather than dropping either requirement.
Failure text specifies standby PUMP even when describing cooler failure. Do not silently substitute a complete standby-cooler sequence.

sequences.view: A1 FAN COIL UNIT WITH HEATING COILS
logic: Heat enable below low-limit temperature with 2 F deadband; otherwise fan/control loops disabled. Source also says to disable cooling-coil loops although scheduled units have heating coils/electric backup.
Below 80 F condenser-water temperature, close hot-water valve and enable electric heat to maintain 55 F.
FC-1 requires two temperature sensors, selecting the lowest reading for heating and backup.
Modulate heating valve to maintain zone temperature when enabled; close when disabled. Direct-wired fan-starter safeties, monitor proof, disable and stop fan until reset on failure.
alarms: Low space temperature: setpoint minus 3 F for 15 minutes
source_conflicts: Heating coil paragraph calls its setpoint ZN-T-HL; supplied numeric list states ZN-T-LL. Preserve symbol ambiguity.
Second FC-1 temperature-sensor input is required but not separately numbered in the typical point list.

logic: Above 80 F zone temperature, open outside-air damper, prove it open, then start exhaust fan. Falling temperature with 5 F deadband stops fan and closes damper.
EF-1 requires two temperature sensors; highest reading governs ventilation.
Hardwired fan-starter safeties and monitored proofs disable controls and stop fan until reset on failure.
source_conflicts: Generic proof list names EF-2 intake and exhaust dampers, while typical matrix includes one intake-damper status and command. Do not invent a separately typed exhaust-damper point.
Second EF-1 sensor is not separately numbered in the matrix.

sequences.view: A4 GENERATOR ROOM EXHAUST FAN/INTAKE AIR CONTROLS
logic: At zone temperature above 80 F open one of three intake dampers and run EF-6 at minimum speed; modulate fan speed to maintain temperature. At falling temperature with 5 F deadband stop EF-6 and close active damper.
Rotate open intake weekly. Next damper must open before current one closes. If a damper fails, open the next in rotation; send critical alarm on open/close failure.
ATS-2 closed OR either/both generators running: open all three intake dampers and de-energize EF-6.
Direct-hardwired safeties and proof monitoring stop controls until reset on failure.
alarms: Failure of any outside-air damper (critical open/close failure)
source_conflicts: Generic proof text says EXHAUST DAMPER EF-2 inside EF-6 sequence, and refers to fan-coil-unit fan shutdown. Retain as apparent copied wording, not an extra EF-2 point.

logic: Use zone AI-1 and 55 F setpoint with 3 F deadband to enable heater; disable above setpoint.
Hardwire safeties; monitor status/proofs and stop until reset on failure.
Source calls for local binary pushbutton RST-BUT and remote DDC reset command.
source_conflicts: RST-BUT and H-S status proof are not separately assigned point marks in the three-row table. No extra physical-input count fabricated.

sequences.view: A4 MEDIUM PRESSURE AIR COMPRESSOR RELIEF CONTROLS
logic: Compressor off: relief damper closed, space damper open.
Compressor cooling-fan discharge airflow proven and zone above heating setpoint: open relief damper, prove open, then close space damper.
Airflow proven and zone below heating setpoint: relief stays closed and space stays open.
AI-1 uses FC-3 zone-temperature sensor input, not a new sensor for each compressor.
Proof/safety failure disables control loops; monitor airflow and both dampers.
Monitor pulse output; record instantaneous, hourly, daily and cumulative flow.
DWM-1: main building meter; DWM-2: pure-water flow; DWM-3: pier flow.
USB/fire-pump freeze-protection flow is calculated DWM-1 minus (DWM-2 plus DWM-3), not another physical meter.
external_references: AP707 domestic-water controls is outside the supplied PDF
source_conflicts: Point matrix labels WATER FLOW PULSE INPUT as ANALOG INPUT/AI1. Terminal technology must be confirmed instead of auto-converting to DI.

sequences.view: A1 SPLIT SYSTEM HEAT PUMP & EXHAUST CONTROLS - GATEHOUSE
logic: Provide manufacturer's 7-day programmable thermostat for cooling, heating, emergency heat and defrost. Coordinate hardwired DDC additional control with thermostat.
When split-system fan runs, open outside-air damper and energize exhaust fan; close outside-air and exhaust dampers when fan is off.
Monitor return-air temperature and humidity.
Auxiliary drain pan float switch shuts unit down on water detection (shown in diagram, not listed as a separate marked BAS point).
alarms: Return temperature above cooling setpoint +3 F for 15 min
Return temperature below heating setpoint -3 F for 15 min
source_conflicts: Sequence repeatedly calls the sensed fan 'split system exhaust fan' while then distinguishing split-system and exhaust fans. Preserve actual fan-status mappings from diagram, rather than adding another fan.

sequences.view: A3 DUCTLESS SPLIT SYSTEM CONTROLS - GATEHOUSE, GUARD BOOTH, AND USB
logic: Ductless system continuously enabled through local unit thermostat, with DDC monitoring space temperature.
Temperature/humidity setpoints are communicated from DDC and measured in associated space; internal unit controls modulate cooling and reduce airflow for dehumidification.
Indoor fan runs whenever zone controller commands unit run.
Guard-booth temperature sensor explicitly not required; do not remove its separately specified local remote controller.
alarms: Space temperature more than 5 F above/below setpoint for more than 30 minutes, adjustable
source_conflicts: Temperature/humidity measurement and communicated setpoint functions exceed the single listed AI-1 temperature row. Required physical vs network points/terminals not separately quantified.
Guard-booth exemption and general monitoring text must be retained together; no unsupported extra DDC sensor.
